item.title: Visualizing Data in Loki
item.description: This section describes how to visualize KubeSphere logs, auditing, events, and notification history data stored in Loki in the Grafana console. Prerequisites The WizTelemetry Platform Service extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. A Grafana console has been deployed via the Grafana for WizTelemetry extension or by other methods. Steps Install the Grafana Loki for WizTelemetry extension.
